title: Orders table
text: Table orders has primary key order_id. Paid rows use status = 'PAID', and created_at stores UTC timestamps.

title: Customers table
text: Table customers has primary key customer_id. Column email_normalized is unique and stores lowercase email addresses.

title: Line items table
text: Table line_item joins orders through order_id. Extended price is quantity * unit_price.

title: Refunds table
text: Table refund references order_id and stores amount_cents. Completed refunds have completed_at set to a non-null value.

title: Inventory table
text: Table inventory is keyed by sku and warehouse_id. Available units equal on_hand - reserved.

title: Events table
text: Table event_log is partitioned by event_date. Its payload column uses JSONB.

title: Subscriptions table
text: Table subscription marks active records with canceled_at IS NULL. Plan code is stored in plan_code.

title: Sessions table
text: Table user_session expires rows using expires_at. Session tokens are stored only as token_hash.

title: Products table
text: Table product uses product_id and has a unique sku. Soft-deleted products set deleted_at.

title: Audit table
text: Table audit_entry records actor_id and action. Rows are ordered chronologically by occurred_at.

title: Warehouses table
text: Table warehouse stores region_code and capacity_units. Only rows with enabled = true accept allocations.

title: Payments table
text: Table payment references order_id. Successful captures use state = 'CAPTURED'.
